newsitem.title: USA: Rally's raises $10.8 mln in rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Rally's raises $10.8 mln in rights offer.

text.p: Rally's Hamburgers Inc said Monday all proposed units in its rights offering were sold, raising more than $10.8 million.

The company said it received offers to purchase twice the number of units offered. It said also that the eventual exercise of the associated warrants could provide an additional $10.8 million in funding.
Proceeds of this offering will be used to build new restaurants, refurbish old restaurants and fund other corporate costs, including debt reduction, the company said.
